question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word.

Sonali uses a __soft__ mattress to sleep.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Hard)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"soft"** means something that is smooth, gentle, or not hard; often used to describe textures, sounds, or behaviors. (नरम)
 
 
• **Example: **The soft fabric of her dress felt pleasant to the touch.
 
 
 
• **"Hard"** refers to something that is firm, solid, and not easily deformable; the opposite of soft. (कठोर)
 
 
• **Example: **The hard surface of the table made writing easy.
